title: Friend spoke to Amy Eskridge hours before her death

tellings.quote: I don't believe that she killed herself. I I just can't because I spoke to her four hours before and she told me time and time again, I'm not going to commit suicide.

plain: A friend of a woman named Amy Eskridge, who died in Alabama in 2022, says he does not believe she killed herself. The friend, who is not named, says he spoke to her four hours before her death and that she told him again and again she was not going to commit suicide. He tells this from his own conversation with her, and if true it would cast doubt on how her death was explained.
